title: Addition for consecutive natural-number ranges
statement: For natural numbers $s,a,b$, the list of $s$ consecutive natural numbers starting at $a+b$ is the concatenation of the list of $s$ consecutive natural numbers starting at $a$ and the list of $b$ consecutive natural numbers starting at $s+a$.
